alt.en: The rule center: eight event switches, dedup window, quiet hours, digest batching, delivery language and the deep link, each channel listed below with its own events filter.
alt.zh: 规则中枢：八类事件开关、去重窗口、免打扰时段、摘要合批、外发语言与点击跳转，下方是各通道及其事件过滤。

caption.en: The rule center — every rule in one official settings section.
caption.zh: 规则中枢 —— 全部规则集中在一个官方设置分区里。

alt.en: The channel editor: one card per channel with its type, endpoint, masked secret and event filter, plus a breaker banner and the deep-link field.
alt.zh: 通道编辑器：每个通道一张卡片，含类型、地址、脱敏密钥与事件过滤，另有熔断提示条与点击跳转字段。

caption.en: Channels, with the deep link and any open breaker explained on the card.
caption.zh: 通道卡片上直接说明点击跳转与熔断状态。

alt.en: The sidebar footer pill beside its delivery panel: every delivery attempt with its event, channel, severity badge and result, including the ones that did not go out.
alt.zh: 侧栏底部的状态胶囊与投递面板：每一次投递尝试连同事件、通道、严重度徽标和结果，含未发出的那些。

caption.en: The pill and its delivery panel — what went out, what did not, and why.
caption.zh: 状态胶囊与投递面板 —— 发了什么、没发什么、为什么。
